CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

October 8, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN (Attended later in the meeting)
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER

Absent:
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: September 24, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the September 24, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Chairman Udani push the consent calendar item to the end of the meeting until
  board member Hernandez is present.
  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  Udani, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  805 South Ninth Street, DRB-2024-00067

  1
   •  Request: This is an application for a new 2,032 SF, 2-story addition to an existing
  1-story single-family residence, and new attached 2-car garage located at the rear
  of the property.
  •  Applicant: Thomas Li
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  Conditions of Approval:
  1. Revise the drawings to clearly identify that the simulated divided light will have
  permanent grills on the exterior of the proposed windows.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  2216 West Main Street, DRB-2024-00081

  •  Request: This is an application for one (1) new wall-mounted sign on an existing
  commercial tenant frontage.
  •  Applicant: Nshan Karibian
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez arrives and attends the meeting for the rest of the
  discussion items, including the consent calendar which was pushed to the end.
  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Revise the elevation to show a dimension measured from finish grade to the
  bottom and the top of the proposed sign.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  2
 ITEM 4:  208 North Cordova Street, DRB-2024-00069

  •  Request: This is an application for exterior improvements and remodeling of an
  existing 2-story single-family residence.
  •  Applicant: Joe Ma
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 5:  230 West Main Street, DRB-2024-00104

  •  Request: This is an application for new metal panel screens mounted on the flat
  roof of an existing 2-story commercial building.
  •  Applicant: Will Vallecios & Sarah Del Rosario
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Revise the elevations to show the extension of the proposed screening above
  the existing parapet with appropriate dimensions.
  2. Provide additional details of the proposed screening, such as thickness of the
  solid panel, matte paint or corrugated finish, and dimension of the gap for
  louvered openings.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  3
 ITEM 6:  69 East Main Street, DRB-2024-00111

  •  Request: This is an application for a vertical extension of the storefront system to
  enclose an existing unfinished wall with new Spandrel glass.
  •  Applicant: Steven Schechter
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:53 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on October 22, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:53 P.M.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________

Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
